title: Nine Lines and One Curtain
subtitle: 戏剧与影视 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧与影视（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧与影视（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：actress　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 actress 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 an ① actress played nine parts in one season and was paid for four, and my grandmother said that was the whole history of it. The ② actress, meaning the woman and not the parts, was thirty-one and had been told her name was wrong; an actress, she said, is somebody who is asked to be both the part and the advertisement for it. She said the advertisement was the harder of the two.

Every ③ actress in that company was called by a different name in the programme, and she said that was not an accident either. Their  actress — the one my mother loved — had nine lines and stole the evening; an actress, my father said, is the only performer who is judged on the way in and the way out. He said the way out is the one they remember.

My aunt said she had been ④ an actress for eleven weeks in 1949, by which she meant a chorus, and my mother said that counted. The ⑤ actress, meaning the profession and not the woman, is nine parts waiting and one part being looked at; an actress, my grandmother said, is the only worker whose appearance is part of the contract and not part of the work. She said the contract said nine words about it.

By 1963 the  actress had taken nine curtain calls and one of them was for somebody else. The ⑥ actress in the photograph by the door had died in 1951 and was still in the programme; an actress, my father said, is either a person or a photograph, and the management prefers the photograph. He said the photograph cost eleven shillings.

The ⑦ actress I remember is the one with nine lines, whom the reviews did not mention once. An ⑧ actress, my grandmother said in 1968, is the only person who is famous for being looked at and blamed for looking; every actress, she said, is two jobs, and only one of them is written down. She said the other one is the one that pays.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 女演员（一个人）
B. n. 女演员（指人本身，与角色相对）
C. n. 女演员（指只有九句台词、评论一次也没提的那一位）
D. n. 女演员（指合唱队里、短期从艺的那一位）
E. n. 女演员（指这个职业、这门行当）
F. n. 女演员（泛指这类人）
G. n. 女演员（指照片里那一位）
H. n. 女演员（抽象总称）

items.q: The actress, meaning the woman and not the parts
an actress for eleven weeks in 1949
An actress, my grandmother said in 1968

answers.why: actress 意为“女演员”，1956 年有一位女演员一个演出季演了九个角色，只拿到四个角色的钱。
actress 指“人本身”，与角色相对，那位女演员三十一岁，有人告诉她她的名字不对。
actress 泛指“女演员这类人”，那个剧团里每一位女演员在节目单上都用另一个名字，她说那也不是偶然。
actress 指合唱队里、短期从艺的那一位，姑姑说她在 1949 年当过十一个星期的女演员，指的是合唱队。
actress 指“这个职业、这门行当”，与人相对，是九分等待加一分被观看。
actress 指照片里那一位，门边照片上那位女演员 1951 年就去世了，却仍在节目单上。
actress 指只有九句台词、评论一次也没提的那一位，我记得的就是她。
actress 为抽象总称，祖母说女演员是唯一因被观看而出名、又因被观看而受责怪的人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年有一位女演员一个演出季演了九个角色，只拿到四个角色的钱。（actress）
那位女演员，指的是人而不是那些角色，三十一岁，有人告诉她她的名字不对。（actress）

姑姑说她在 1949 年当过十一个星期的女演员，指的是合唱队。（actress）

answers: In 1956 an actress played nine parts in one season and was paid for four, and my grandmother said that was the whole history of it.

Every actress in that company was called by a different name in the programme, and she said that was not an accident either.
Their actress, the one my mother loved, had nine lines and stole the evening.
My aunt said she had been an actress for eleven weeks in 1949, by which she meant a chorus, and my mother said that counted.
